senses.gloss: ka (IE 8-1), for kā (in Kharoṣṭhī), abbreviation of kāla.
kad̤ā (IE 8-6; EI 19), Bengali; the cowrie-shell regarded as a coin; a small area of land; one-fourth of a gaṇḍā and one-eightieth of a paṇa.

kal̤̣añju (IE 8-8; EI 28, 30; SITI), Tamil; name of a gold coin; also of the equivalent weight; about 32 ratis (JNSI, Vol. XV, p. 141).
 Cf. ūr-kal̤̣añju (EI 28), name of a coin.
 (SII 13), same as suvarṇa.
kan̤n̤ār-ir̤ai (SITI), Tamil; profession tax payable by a brazier.
kad̤ā , Bengali, etc; cowrie-shell regarded as coin; (1/4) of gaṇḍā and (1/80) of paṇa in some areas. Cf. kapardaka, etc.
kal̤̣añju , Tamil; name of a weight or coin weighing 10 mañjāḍis (32 ratis theoretically); sometimes called suvarṇa (q. v.).
kā (PJS), abbreviation of kārita and kāritā (especially in medieval Jain inscriptions); also of Kāyastha; also of kāṇḍa, ‘a cluster’ (JAS, Letters, Vol. XX, p. 204).
